basis.role: context compiler and bounded resource selection

minimal_packet.question: What is the next independently useful, safe, reversible CoOrbWare/X2 continuation test?
minimal_packet.elected_action: Qualify one X2 receiver path and one first-use CoWorkObject handoff without copying private conversation text into other accounts
uncertainty: X2 remote connection observed OFFLINE; OS status not inferred
no live cross-window shared work object
CoOmni R1 compiler reported local tests, not production binding
no independent user acceptance or off-provider cold restore

projection_modes.behavior: Pin source revision and show unchanged historic meaning
Show newer source pointer only after exact observed revision checks
Display explicit diff/currentness and hold missing receiver acknowledgment
Compile role-scoped context without importing passwords or raw private chats
Glanceable source/effect/heartbeat, no inferred current runtime

typed_relations.meaning: may be bidirectional, not necessarily equal
absence only under an explicitly closed checked scope
unbounded addressable ideas, finite active capacity
